decisions.statement: The credential is read from the keychain as the tile is drawn.
A cached reading has the moment the cached reading was written.
A cached reading is let go once that reading is older than the age the route refuses.
A reading let go is drawn as no reading rather than as a number.
A feed names the moment its tile changes on its own or names no moment.
A feed naming no moment is given the one entry and the one refresh that feed had.
A feed naming a moment still to come is given a second entry at that moment.
The second entry is the payload already in hand held against a later date.
The second entry fetches nothing and is no refresh.
A moment already past is given no entry rather than an entry in the past.
The refresh stays fifteen minutes out however near the named moment is.
A provider states the kind its tile is placed under.
The kind is paired with the feed's path where the freshness tile reads it.
A surplus falling thirty-two an hour reaches the rung four under that surplus in seven minutes.
Refreshing at each moment named would spend in one costly block a whole day of reloads.
A moment named carries no word on whether the server's reading changed.

definition: the fetch every tile of Alan's app draws from
